title: Old vs New - UI rebuild - What do you think guys?
author: BSwayzeYo
selftext:
Sorry for the lack of tech talk in this post. I just wanted to pop in and show my fellow aidevs all the work I've done on the UI over the last 3 days.   
The new double panel page opens all at once with a single click and the left side functions as a masteries/character skills progression and build choice tiered system, and the right panel functions as an equipment manager AND a shop/unlock system to spend game coins earned from caching fish to unlock bigger and bigger lure.

What do you guys think? Upgrade or nah?

comments.author: BenTheSodaman
comments.body: While they both got the job done, I have a preference for the new look so far.

replies.author: BSwayzeYo
replies.body: Thank you for checking it out and sharing your opinion! I appreciate it. 🎉🎣
